items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: The rhythm section was me, Richard Davis and Percy Brice.

ctx.x: That was — let’s see — four saxes, one trombone player, two trumpets. It was a small band, a twelve piece band probably. The rhythm section was me, Richard Davis and Percy Brice. And nine other guys. We had no guitar. But it had to be a nice band.
The time with Sarah was early 1960s?
